description: Get today's puzzle at any of six difficulties — from Beginner to Diabolical — on a board you can actually play, or generate a fresh puzzle whenever you want one. More importantly, learn how to solve: every hint names the real technique in play and teaches you to spot it yourself, drawn from our Sudoku University teaching program and its twenty-technique glossary.

defaultPrompt: Give me an easy sudoku and teach me how to solve it
